content: Hi there! How can I help you today? Are you looking for our reunion photo album or need help downloading the pictures?
Hi! Yes, I heard there's a shared album with all the reunion photos. Could you send me the link?
Of course! Here's the album link: <reunion_album_link>. Once you open it, you can browse through all the group shots, candids, and even the highlight video.
Thanks! When I open the album, can I download the original resolution photos? I'd love to keep them.
Absolutely! Just click any photo you like, and then select 'Download original' for the best quality. You can even download the whole album as a ZIP if you'd like.
Some of the photos are missing captions. Is there a way to add them?

Great point! Anyone with access can help by clicking 'Edit captions' beneath each photo. Simple captions or names really help everyone remember the moments, and they're especially helpful for accessibility.
That's nice. Are these photos view-only? I don't want anyone accidentally deleting anything.
Yes, the album is set to view-only for everyone except the organizers, so your memories are safe. Feel free to browse, comment, or download, but editing and deleting are restricted.
A few people asked if it's okay to upload their own photos. Is that possible?

We can invite contributors! If anyone wants to share their photos, just let me know and I'll send them an upload link. Remind them to add a simple description and only upload images they have permission to share.
Awesome, thanks! I'll start by downloading the group photo now.
Perfect! Click on the group photo and hit 'Download original' for the full-quality image. Let me know if you run into any issues or want more tips for organizing your favorites.
